senses.en: to take in and fully understand information or ideas
to become part of a group or culture; to absorb into a larger group

ex.en: It took the immigrants years to assimilate into their new culture.
ex.zh: 這些移民花了好幾年才融入新的文化。

senses.en: repetition of similar vowel sounds in nearby words

ex.en: "Hear the mellow wedding bells" uses assonance with its repeated "e" sounds.
ex.zh: Hear the mellow wedding bells 這句用了重複的 e 音，形成母音韻。

root.note: 聲音彼此呼應 → 母音韻

senses.en: having repeated or similar vowel sounds

ex.en: The poet chose assonant words like "lake" and "fade" to create a soft rhythm.
ex.zh: 詩人挑選 lake 和 fade 這類母音押韻的字，營造柔和的節奏。

root.note: 聲音相呼應的 → 母音押韻的

senses.en: to correspond in vowel sound; to rhyme by vowel sounds

ex.en: In this line, "time" and "light" assonate but do not fully rhyme.
ex.zh: 在這行詩裡，time 和 light 母音押韻，但不算完全押韻。

root.note: 聲音相呼應 → 母音押韻

senses.en: to make an unpleasant feeling less intense
to satisfy a need such as hunger or thirst

ex.en: The mayor tried to assuage fears that the water was unsafe.
ex.zh: 市長試圖緩解民眾對水質不安全的恐懼。

senses.en: causing skin or body tissue to tighten
sharp or severe in manner or style
a substance that tightens skin or tissue

ex.en: The critic's astringent review hurt the young author's feelings.
ex.zh: 評論家尖刻的書評傷了那位年輕作者的心。

root.note: 使綁緊的 → 收斂的；嚴厲的

senses.en: able to judge situations accurately and use them to one's advantage

ex.en: An astute investor noticed the trend before anyone else.
ex.zh: 一位精明的投資人比其他人更早察覺這個趨勢。

senses.en: the belief that God or gods do not exist

ex.en: The book explores the history of atheism in Western thought.
ex.zh: 這本書探討西方思想中無神論的歷史。

root.note: 沒有神的主義 → 無神論

senses.en: (literary) eager or longing for something; thirsty

ex.en: The young scholar was athirst for knowledge of ancient languages.
ex.zh: 那位年輕學者渴望學習古代語言的知識。

senses.en: across from side to side; across the path of
in opposition to; contrary to what is expected

ex.en: A fallen tree lay athwart the road after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，一棵倒下的樹橫在路上。

senses.en: a device that turns liquid into a fine spray

ex.en: She sprayed perfume from a glass atomizer.
ex.zh: 她用玻璃噴霧瓶噴香水。

root.note: 把液體變成微粒的器具 → 噴霧器

senses.en: to do something to make up for a wrong or sin

ex.en: He volunteered every weekend to atone for his past mistakes.
ex.zh: 他每個週末都去當志工，彌補過去犯的錯。

root.note: at one（重歸於好）→ 彌補、贖罪

mn: 拆成 at-one：做了補償，雙方才能重新「合而為一」。

senses.en: the act of making up for a wrong or sin

ex.en: She offered to repaint the fence as atonement for the damage.
ex.zh: 她提議重新油漆籬笆，作為損壞的補償。

senses.en: extremely bad or unpleasant
extremely cruel or wicked

ex.en: The service at the restaurant was atrocious, so we left early.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的服務糟透了，所以我們提早離開。

senses.en: an extremely cruel or violent act, especially in war

ex.en: The museum documents every atrocity committed during the war.
ex.zh: 這間博物館記錄了戰爭期間的每一樁暴行。

senses.en: to provide or serve as clear evidence of
to declare that something is true, especially formally

ex.en: Thousands of fans can attest to the band's amazing live shows.
ex.zh: 成千上萬的歌迷都能證明這個樂團的現場演出有多精彩。

senses.en: the chief legal officer of a country or state

ex.en: The attorney-general announced a new investigation into the company.
ex.zh: 司法部長宣布對那家公司展開新的調查。

root.note: 首席律師 → 司法部長

senses.en: (of hair) reddish-brown

ex.en: The girl with auburn hair won first prize in the spelling bee.
ex.zh: 那個赤褐色頭髮的女孩贏得拼字比賽冠軍。

senses.en: showing a willingness to take bold risks
showing a rude lack of respect

ex.en: The team made an audacious attempt to climb the mountain in winter.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍大膽嘗試在冬天攀登這座山。

senses.en: able to be heard

ex.en: Her voice was barely audible over the noise of the crowd.
ex.zh: 在人群的喧鬧聲中，她的聲音幾乎聽不見。

senses.en: a short performance to test whether a performer is suitable for a role
to perform in or hold an audition

ex.en: She practiced the song all week for her audition.
ex.zh: 她整個星期都在練這首歌，準備試鏡。

senses.en: relating to the sense of hearing

ex.en: Some students are auditory learners who remember best by listening.
ex.zh: 有些學生是聽覺型學習者，靠聽最容易記住。

root.note: 與聽有關的 → 聽覺的

senses.en: to make something greater by adding to it

ex.en: He took a weekend job to augment his income.
ex.zh: 他找了份週末工作來增加收入。

senses.en: to be a sign of a likely future outcome
a fortune-teller in ancient Rome who read signs from birds

ex.en: The strong sales numbers augur well for the new company.
ex.zh: 亮眼的銷售數字對這家新公司來說是個好兆頭。

parts.m: increase 增加（一說源自 avis 鳥）

root.note: 古羅馬占卜官觀察飛鳥預測吉凶 → 預示

mn: 常用 augur well / augur ill，表示「是好兆頭／壞兆頭」。

senses.en: relating to St. Augustine or his teachings
a member of a religious order following the rule of St. Augustine

ex.en: The scholar studied the Augustinian idea of original sin.
ex.zh: 那位學者研究聖奧古斯丁的原罪觀。

senses.en: a distinctive feeling or quality that seems to surround a person or place

ex.en: The old library had an aura of mystery.
ex.zh: 那座老圖書館散發著一股神祕的氣息。

root.note: 周圍的一陣氣息 → 氣氛

senses.en: relating to the ear or to hearing

ex.en: The music exam includes an aural test of rhythm and pitch.
ex.zh: 音樂考試包含節奏和音高的聽力測驗。

mn: aural（聽覺的）和 oral（口頭的）發音幾乎一樣，要看拼字分辨。

senses.en: the outer part of the ear
an upper chamber of the heart (atrium)

ex.en: The doctor examined the auricle for signs of infection.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查外耳有沒有感染的跡象。

senses.en: relating to the ear or hearing
told privately into someone's ear

ex.en: Catholic confession is sometimes called auricular confession because it is spoken privately.
ex.zh: 天主教的告解有時被稱作「耳語告解」，因為是私下說的。

senses.en: containing gold

ex.en: Miners flocked to the auriferous hills of California.
ex.zh: 礦工們蜂擁至加州產金的山區。

root.note: 帶有黃金的 → 含金的

senses.en: natural bands of colored light in the sky near the poles
(literary) the dawn

ex.en: We stayed up all night to watch the aurora over Iceland.
ex.zh: 我們整晚不睡，只為了看冰島上空的極光。

parts.m: dawn 黎明（羅馬黎明女神）

root.note: 黎明女神 → 曙光、極光

senses.en: (usually auspices) support or sponsorship
a sign of what will happen; an omen

ex.en: The ancient priest read the flight of birds as a favorable auspice.
ex.zh: 古代祭司把鳥群的飛行視為吉兆。

root.note: 觀察鳥來占卜 → 預兆

mn: 常用片語 under the auspices of，意為「在…的贊助／主辦下」。

senses.en: severe or strict in manner or attitude
plain and without decoration or comfort

ex.en: The monks lived in austere rooms with only a bed and a desk.
ex.zh: 僧侶們住在只有一張床和一張桌子的簡樸房間裡。

parts.m: harsh, dry 嚴酷、乾澀（希臘文）

root.note: 嚴酷乾澀 → 嚴峻、樸素

senses.en: absolute rule by one person; autocracy
economic self-sufficiency (also spelled autarky)

ex.en: Under the emperor's autarchy, no one dared to question his orders.
ex.zh: 在皇帝的專制統治下，沒人敢質疑他的命令。

root.note: 一個人自己統治 → 獨裁

senses.en: real or genuine; not fake
accurate and reliable; true to the original

ex.en: This small restaurant serves authentic Thai food.
ex.zh: 這家小餐館供應道地的泰國菜。

root.note: 自己親手做的 → 真正的

senses.en: the quality of being real, genuine, or true

ex.en: Experts questioned the authenticity of the old letter.
ex.zh: 專家質疑這封舊信的真實性。

root.note: 真正的性質 → 真實性

senses.en: an account of a person's life written by that person

ex.en: In her autobiography, the scientist describes growing up on a farm.
ex.zh: 這位科學家在自傳中描述了她在農場長大的經歷。

root.note: 自己寫自己的生平 → 自傳

senses.en: a system of government in which one person has absolute power

ex.en: The country slowly moved from autocracy toward democracy.
ex.zh: 這個國家慢慢從獨裁走向民主。

root.note: 一個人自己統治 → 獨裁政治

senses.en: a ruler with absolute power; a person who insists on complete obedience

ex.en: The boss ran the office like an autocrat, ignoring everyone's suggestions.
ex.zh: 老闆像獨裁者一樣管理辦公室，對大家的建議一概不理。

root.note: 自己一人說了算的統治者 → 獨裁者

senses.en: a moving mechanical figure or robot
a person who acts mechanically without thinking

ex.en: After the night shift, he moved like an automaton.
ex.zh: 值完夜班後，他整個人像機器人一樣機械地動作。

root.note: 自己會動的東西 → 自動機械

senses.en: having self-government; independent
able to operate without human control

ex.en: The company is testing an autonomous car on city streets.
ex.zh: 那家公司正在市區街道測試自動駕駛汽車。

root.note: 自己訂法則的 → 自治的

senses.en: the right or condition of self-government
freedom to make one's own decisions

ex.en: Teenagers often want more autonomy over their own schedules.
ex.zh: 青少年常希望對自己的時間安排有更多自主權。

senses.en: an examination of a dead body to find the cause of death

ex.en: An autopsy showed that the man had died of a heart attack.
ex.zh: 驗屍結果顯示，那名男子死於心臟病發作。

senses.en: relating to or typical of autumn
past the prime of life

ex.en: The hills glowed with autumnal shades of red and gold.
ex.zh: 山丘閃耀著紅色和金色的秋日色彩。

senses.en: providing extra help or support
a helper or extra worker; (grammar) a helping verb

ex.en: The hospital has an auxiliary generator in case the power fails.
ex.zh: 醫院有一台備用發電機，以防停電。

root.note: 提供幫助的 → 輔助的

senses.en: a large mass of snow and ice falling rapidly down a mountain
a sudden, overwhelming amount of something

ex.en: The singer received an avalanche of messages after her performance.
ex.zh: 演出之後，那位歌手收到如雪片般湧來的訊息。

senses.en: extreme greed for wealth or material gain

ex.en: His avarice drove him to cheat his own business partners.
ex.zh: 貪婪驅使他去欺騙自己的生意夥伴。

root.note: 極度渴望（錢財）→ 貪婪

senses.en: to state firmly that something is true

ex.en: The witness continued to aver that she had seen the suspect.
ex.zh: 證人仍然堅稱她看到了那名嫌犯。

senses.en: strongly opposed to or disliking something

ex.en: She is not averse to hard work if the pay is fair.
ex.zh: 只要薪水合理，她並不排斥辛苦的工作。

mn: 常用片語 be averse to（厭惡、不願意）；別和 adverse（不利的）搞混。

senses.en: a strong dislike

ex.en: My cat has a strong aversion to water.
ex.zh: 我的貓非常討厭水。

senses.en: to prevent something bad from happening
to turn away one's eyes or thoughts

ex.en: Quick action by the pilot helped avert a disaster.
ex.zh: 機長的迅速反應避免了一場災難。

senses.en: a large cage or building for keeping birds

ex.en: The zoo's aviary houses parrots from around the world.
ex.zh: 動物園的鳥園飼養了來自世界各地的鸚鵡。

senses.en: extreme eagerness or enthusiasm

ex.en: She read mystery novels with an avidity that amazed her friends.
ex.zh: 她看推理小說的熱切程度令朋友們吃驚。

senses.en: a hobby or activity done in addition to one's regular job

ex.en: She is a lawyer by profession, but her avocation is painting.
ex.zh: 她的職業是律師，但她的嗜好是畫畫。

root.note: 被召喚離開本業的事 → 副業、嗜好

mn: vocation 是本業，a-vocation 是本業之外的嗜好。

senses.en: to declare openly and firmly

ex.en: The candidate will avow his support for the new law at tonight's rally.
ex.zh: 這位候選人將在今晚的造勢大會上公開表態支持新法。

root.note: 對眾人發誓 → 公開聲明

senses.en: to wake up or cause to wake up
to make someone aware of or interested in something

ex.en: A trip to the museum helped awaken her interest in history.
ex.zh: 一趟博物館之旅喚起了她對歷史的興趣。

senses.en: away from the expected course; wrong
out of the normal position; crooked

ex.en: Their camping trip went awry when a storm blew away the tent.
ex.zh: 暴風雨把帳篷吹走後，他們的露營之旅就全亂了套。

mn: 常用 go awry，意為「出差錯」。

senses.en: yes (used in voting or in some dialects)
a vote in favor

ex.en: When the chair asked for votes, most members answered "aye."
ex.zh: 主席要求表決時，大多數成員都回答「贊成」。

senses.en: a flowering shrub with bright pink, red, or white blossoms

ex.en: Every spring, the azalea in our yard bursts into pink flowers.
ex.zh: 每年春天，我們院子裡的杜鵑花都會盛開粉紅色的花朵。

root.note: 長在乾燥土壤中的花 → 杜鵑花

senses.en: bright blue like a clear sky
a bright blue color

ex.en: The boat floated on the calm azure sea.
ex.zh: 小船漂浮在平靜蔚藍的海面上。

parts.m: lapis lazuli 青金石（波斯文 lazward）

root.note: 青金石的顏色 → 天藍色

senses.en: relating to Francis Bacon or his method of reasoning from observation
senses.zh: 培根（學說）的；經驗歸納法的

ex.en: Early scientists followed the Baconian method of gathering facts before forming theories.
ex.zh: 早期科學家遵循培根的方法，先蒐集事實再建立理論。

parts.m: 英國哲學家法蘭西斯・培根

senses.en: a single-celled microorganism (plural: bacteria)

ex.en: This bacterium can survive in boiling hot springs.
ex.zh: 這種細菌能在滾燙的溫泉中存活。

root.note: 最早觀察到的細菌呈小棍狀 → 細菌

mn: bacterium 是單數，bacteria 是複數。

senses.en: to repeatedly and annoyingly ask someone to do something
a heavily built animal with black and white stripes that lives in burrows

ex.en: The kids continued to badger their parents for a new puppy.
ex.zh: 孩子們不斷纏著爸媽要養新的小狗。

senses.en: to totally confuse or puzzle someone

ex.en: The strange symptoms continue to baffle doctors.
ex.zh: 這些奇怪的症狀持續讓醫生們百思不解。

senses.en: an officer who keeps order in a courtroom
(British) an official who takes property to pay debts

ex.en: The bailiff asked everyone in the courtroom to rise.
ex.zh: 法警請法庭上所有人起立。

root.note: 負責看管的人 → 法警

senses.en: a thick green woolen cloth used to cover pool and card tables

ex.en: The billiard table was covered in fresh green baize.
ex.zh: 撞球桌鋪上了嶄新的綠色粗呢。

senses.en: a large bundle of hay, cotton, or other material tied tightly
to make into bales

ex.en: The farmer lifted a heavy bale of hay onto the truck.
ex.zh: 農夫把一大捆沉重的乾草抬上卡車。

senses.en: threatening harm; menacing

ex.en: The guard dog gave us a baleful stare from behind the fence.
ex.zh: 看門狗從籬笆後面兇狠地瞪著我們。

senses.en: a poem or song that tells a story
a slow, romantic popular song

ex.en: The singer ended the concert with a quiet love ballad.
ex.zh: 歌手以一首輕柔的抒情情歌為演唱會收尾。

root.note: 原指伴舞的歌 → 歌謠

senses.en: a sweet-smelling oily substance from certain trees, used in medicine
something that soothes or heals

ex.en: The healer rubbed a soothing balsam on the wound.
ex.zh: 醫者在傷口上抹了一層舒緩的香膏。

senses.en: so ordinary or overused as to be boring
senses.zh: 陳腔濫調的；平庸乏味的

ex.en: The movie was full of banal dialogue and predictable jokes.
ex.zh: 這部電影充滿陳腔濫調的台詞和老套的笑話。

senses.en: a song traditionally sung by Venetian gondoliers, or music in that style

ex.en: The pianist played a gentle barcarole that sounded like rocking waves.
ex.zh: 鋼琴家彈奏了一首輕柔的船歌，聽起來就像搖晃的波浪。

senses.en: a male singing voice between tenor and bass, or a singer with this voice

ex.en: He sang the role in a rich, warm baritone.
ex.zh: 他用渾厚溫暖的男中音演唱這個角色。

root.note: 低沉的聲調 → 男中音

senses.en: a barometer that records changes in air pressure on paper

ex.en: The barograph showed a sharp drop in pressure before the storm.
ex.zh: 自記氣壓計顯示暴風雨來臨前氣壓急遽下降。

root.note: 把氣壓寫下來的儀器 → 自記氣壓計

senses.en: an instrument that measures air pressure
something that shows changes in public opinion or conditions

ex.en: Consumer spending is a useful barometer of the economy's health.
ex.zh: 消費支出是衡量經濟是否健康的實用指標。

senses.en: except for; if something does not happen

ex.en: Barring any delays, the train will arrive at noon.
ex.zh: 如果沒有延誤，火車將在中午抵達。

root.note: 把某事擋在外面 → 除…之外

senses.en: to lie in warmth and sunlight for pleasure
to enjoy praise or attention

ex.en: Lizards bask on warm rocks to raise their body temperature.
ex.zh: 蜥蜴躺在溫暖的石頭上曬太陽，提高體溫。

senses.en: the lowest male singing voice; the lowest range of musical sound
a bass guitar or double bass
[bæs] a kind of freshwater or sea fish

ex.en: He plays bass in a jazz band on weekends.
ex.zh: 他週末在一個爵士樂團裡彈貝斯。

mn: 當「低音、貝斯」時唸 [bes]（同 base），當「鱸魚」時唸 [bæs]。

senses.en: to pour juices or melted fat over meat while it cooks
to sew with long, loose, temporary stitches

ex.en: Remember to baste the turkey every thirty minutes.
ex.zh: 記得每三十分鐘在火雞上淋一次油。

senses.en: a thin stick used by a conductor to lead an orchestra
a short stick passed between runners in a relay race
a police officer's club

ex.en: The last runner dropped the baton just before the finish line.
ex.zh: 最後一棒的跑者在終點線前掉了接力棒。

mn: pass the baton 可比喻「交棒、傳承責任」。

senses.en: a large military unit made up of several companies
a large group of people

ex.en: A battalion of soldiers was sent to help after the flood.
ex.zh: 一個營的士兵被派去協助水災救援。

senses.en: a long, narrow strip of wood used to hold something in place
to fasten or secure with strips of wood

ex.en: Before the typhoon, we had to batten down the windows.
ex.zh: 颱風來之前，我們得先把窗戶釘牢。

mn: batten down the hatches 原指船員封好艙口，比喻「做好迎接困難的準備」。

senses.en: to hit repeatedly and violently
a mixture of flour, eggs, and milk used in cooking
(baseball) the player trying to hit the ball

ex.en: Huge waves continued to batter the coast all night.
ex.zh: 巨浪整晚不停地猛烈拍打著海岸。

senses.en: a small, cheap decorative object

ex.en: She hung a shiny bauble on the Christmas tree.
ex.zh: 她在聖誕樹上掛了一顆亮晶晶的小飾品。

senses.en: to cry loudly
to shout or call out loudly

ex.en: The baby began to bawl as soon as the plane took off.
ex.zh: 飛機一起飛，嬰兒就開始放聲大哭。

mn: bawl out someone 是口語，表示「痛罵某人」。

senses.en: (in the Catholic Church) to declare a dead person blessed, a step toward sainthood
to make extremely happy

ex.en: The pope will beatify the nun at a ceremony next year.
ex.zh: 教宗將在明年的典禮上為這位修女宣福。

root.note: 使成為有福的人 → 宣福

senses.en: supreme happiness or blessedness
(the Beatitudes) the blessings spoken by Jesus in the Sermon on the Mount

ex.en: The saint's face in the painting shows a look of calm beatitude.
ex.zh: 畫中聖人的臉上流露出平靜的至福神情。

senses.en: a boyfriend or male admirer (old-fashioned)

ex.en: Grandma still keeps the letters from her first beau.
ex.zh: 奶奶至今還保存著初戀男友寫給她的信。

root.note: 俊美的男子 → 男朋友

senses.en: (of a sailing ship) to be unable to move because there is no wind
to make calm

ex.en: A sudden loss of wind could becalm the sailboat for hours.
ex.zh: 風突然停了，帆船可能會停在原地好幾個小時。

root.note: 使平靜 → 因無風而停航

senses.en: a gesture calling someone, as in "at someone's beck and call"
(northern England) a small stream

ex.en: He expects his assistants to be at his beck and call day and night.
ex.zh: 他要求助理們日夜隨傳隨到。

mn: 幾乎只用在片語 at someone's beck and call（隨叫隨到）。

senses.en: to smear or cover with something sticky or dirty

ex.en: The toddlers managed to bedaub the walls with finger paint.
ex.zh: 那群幼兒竟然用手指畫顏料把牆壁塗得亂七八糟。

senses.en: to decorate lavishly

ex.en: Volunteers will bedeck the streets with flags for the festival.
ex.zh: 志工們會在街上掛滿旗子，為節慶做裝飾。

senses.en: a scene of uproar and confusion

ex.en: When the fire alarm went off, the cafeteria turned into bedlam.
ex.zh: 火災警報一響，餐廳立刻陷入一片混亂。

parts.m: Bethlehem 伯利恆（倫敦一家精神病院的俗稱）

root.note: 舊時倫敦的瘋人院 → 混亂吵鬧的場面

senses.en: to confuse or make unclear
to cover with fog

ex.en: Too much technical language can befog the main point of an argument.
ex.zh: 太多專業術語會讓論點的重點變得模糊。

root.note: 使籠罩在霧中 → 使模糊

senses.en: to become a friend to someone, especially someone who needs help
senses.zh: 與…交朋友；照顧（需要幫助的人）

ex.en: She made an effort to befriend the new student from Japan.
ex.zh: 她主動和從日本來的新同學交朋友。

senses.en: to cause or give rise to
(old use) to become the father of

ex.en: Violence tends to beget more violence.
ex.zh: 暴力往往會招致更多暴力。

senses.en: to envy someone for something they have
to give something reluctantly

ex.en: I don't begrudge her the award; she worked hard for it.
ex.zh: 我不嫉妒她得獎，那是她努力換來的。

senses.en: (old use) to make late; to delay

ex.en: The old diary complains that storms would often belate the mail coach.
ex.zh: 那本舊日記抱怨，暴風雨常常讓郵車延誤。

mn: 現代幾乎只用形容詞 belated（遲來的），例如 a belated birthday gift。

senses.en: to secure a climber or rope with a safety line
(nautical, as a command) to stop

ex.en: Her partner will belay her while she climbs the rock wall.
ex.zh: 她攀爬岩壁時，她的搭檔會幫她確保。

root.note: 把繩子牢牢固定 → 確保

senses.en: to give a false impression of; to hide the true nature of
to show something to be false

ex.en: His calm smile could not belie the fear in his eyes.
ex.zh: 他平靜的笑容掩飾不了眼中的恐懼。
